_comment: TD-107 tracked synthetic six-worker registry. Replaces the canonical test path's dependency on the gitignored, machine-local config/agents.json (which does not exist in a clean checkout and is reserved for operation acceptance). Modeled on config/agents.example.json (the schema-valid SSOT exemplar) so it passes readRegistry normalization + each backend's validateAgentPolicy. Secret-free: tokenEnv is an env-var NAME, never a credential value. Exactly the six primary workers. R8-C C-11: every cwd is '.' (aligned with the R8-1 template value) — a placeholder absolute path like D:/projects/your-project made doctor's cwd_* face machine-state-coupled (the path exists on some machines and not others, flipping WARN counts and verdicts between checkouts); '.' resolves against the dispatching process cwd on every machine, so DOCTOR_REGISTRY consumers observe the same deterministic check set everywhere.
